# France Rework - French Africa held by allies (generated by build_ff_return.py)
FRW_french_africa_land = {
	is_on_continent = africa
	OR = { is_core_of = FRA is_claimed_by = FRA has_state_flag = FRW_french_colony }
	NOT = { is_controlled_by = FRA }
}
FRW_ally_holds_french_africa = {
	is_in_faction_with = FRA
	NOT = { tag = FRA }
	any_controlled_state = { FRW_french_africa_land = yes }
}
